injuries.name: Precious Achiuwa
injuries.note: Achiuwa (ankle) is out for Friday's game against the Trail Blazers.

injuries.name: Maxime Raynaud
injuries.note: Raynaud (knee) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against Orlando.

injuries.name: Ben Simmons
injuries.note: Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.

injuries.name: Ja Morant
injuries.note: Head coach Micah Nori said Morant met with a doctor in Los Angeles, who gave him a positive outlook on his recovery from the hamstring injury. While Nori declined to update Morant's timetable, he added Morant "may not be out for as long as we thought," Trail Blazers Insider Sean Highkin reports.

injuries.name: Chris Youngblood
injuries.note: Youngblood (foot) is out for Friday's game against Sacramento.

injuries.name: Vit Krejci
injuries.note: Krejci underwent surgery on his fractured left ankle Wednesday and will be re-evaluated in eight weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

injuries.name: Shaedon Sharpe
injuries.note: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

injuries.name: Brandon Ingram
injuries.note: Ingram (Achilles) won't play in Friday's game against the Thunder, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

injuries.name: Yanic Konan Niederhauser
injuries.note: Niederhauser (foot) is out for Tuesday's game against Phoenix, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.

injuries.name: Bradley Beal
injuries.note: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.

injuries.name: Jordan Miller
injuries.note: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

injuries.name: Ajay Mitchell
injuries.note: Mitchell (ankle) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Clippers.

injuries.name: Jaylin Williams
injuries.note: Williams (back) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against Portland and remains out indefinitely.

injuries.name: Chet Holmgren
injuries.note: Holmgren underwent a biological treatment Friday to address a small patellar tendon tear and will miss at least 8-10 weeks, Nick Crain of Slam reports.

injuries.name: Jalen Williams
injuries.note: Williams (leg) underwent successful surgery Wednesday to "address a fractured left fibula and reconstruction of ankle ligaments following a fracture and dislocation." He will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Tim MacMahon of ESPN.com reports.

injuries.name: Cason Wallace
injuries.note: Wallace underwent surgery Friday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

injuries.name: Thomas Sorber
injuries.note: Sorber (knee) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Clippers.

night.headline: Pass tonight: no bet still has an edge once the model's edge is halved. Skipping costs no expected growth and cuts variance.
reasons: No total or parlay passed the edge filter tonight (each needs a conservative edge of at least the floor before it is sized), so nothing reaches the growth gate.
Reference ticket shrunk expected profit: 0.000% of bankroll (PASS below 0.050%, BET from 0.150%).
Reference tier: standard (200 units of $0.50 on $100); Kelly fraction 0.25 on shrunk edge.
At the reference unit no bet is placeable: one $0.50 unit is 0.5% of bankroll and no stake of that size grows the bankroll on any bet.
Shrinkage: totals and parlays at s = 0.5 (realised edge about half of claimed on 821 replay bets); props at s = 0, informational.

PrizePicks: the board could not be read from the server, so 40 player legs come with take-it thresholds instead of picks. Check them in the app; a slip is worth playing only where its lines meet the thresholds.

notes: Payout table (partly an assumption): Power 2/3/4/5/6 picks pay 3x/6x/10x/20x/37.5x and Flex 3/4/5/6 picks pay 3x/6x/10x/25x when all hit, per PrizePicks' help centre as summarised by web search on 2026-11-07 (the site itself is blocked from the build host). Flex partial tiers (3-pick 1x with one miss, 4-pick 1.5x, 5-pick 2x/0.4x, 6-pick 2x/0.4x) are from secondary sources. PrizePicks notes some lineups (e.g. several players from one game) pay differently: check the multiplier the app shows.
Minimum entry assumed $5 (official help centre, via web search 2026-11-07); Happy Hour promos can be lower.

Standard (non-Demon/Goblin) projections only. A voided pick (the player sits, or a tie on a whole-number line) is assumed to drop the slip one size at that size's payout; under two live picks it is refunded.
A slip needs players from at least two teams (assumed PrizePicks rule), and its picks are treated as independent.
PrizePicks board unavailable: blocked (HTTP 403): PrizePicks refuses this network; DraftKings lines used as the proxy.
The reference ledger records at most 2 $5 entries per night (the 10% night cap on $100); slips are ranked.
Pick'em edges are PROVISIONAL: no historical PrizePicks line archive exists, so the leg probabilities are market-anchored (DraftKings) and shrunk at s = 0.5 until the live ledger grades enough slips.

PrizePicks lines were not available to the server, so these legs use DraftKings' main line as a stand-in. A slip is only worth playing where PrizePicks posts a line at or better than each leg's take-it threshold (More if the line is at most X, Less if at least Y). Type the app's lines into the table to re-price.
Fliff minimum wager assumed $0.25 (ASSUMPTION, unverified; configurable in jghedge.config).
Game totals and cross-game parlays only; spreads and moneylines are informational (lost in two of three replayed seasons).
Lines are DraftKings via ESPN unless an Odds API key supplies Fliff's own number; bet the number shown or better.

growth.basis: bootstrap of nightly returns from data/replay_open.json seasons 2024-2027 (1032 nights, both seeds); returns are the balanced profile at k=0.25 scaled by k/0.25 for other k; each night's stake is split across its bets, rounded to whole units, capped at 5% per bet and 10% per night, and the night is skipped when a bet rounds below one unit; 2000 paths of 160 nights, seed 1
